#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

const HELP = `memo init                         set up memory in this repo
memo note -t decision "text"      log a decision (also: error, next)
memo note --personal "text"       save a fact about you (~/.memo)
memo brief                        regenerate .memory/BRIEF.md
memo hook                         (internal) called by git post-commit
`;

function main(argv) {
  const cmd = argv[2];
  switch (cmd) {
    case 'init':
      require('../src/init.js')();
      break;
    case 'note':
      require('../src/note.js')(argv.slice(3));
      break;
    case 'hook':
      require('../src/hook.js')();
      break;
    case 'brief':
      require('../src/brief.js').command();
      break;
    case '--help':
    case '-h':
    case undefined:
      process.stdout.write(HELP);
      break;
    default:
      process.stderr.write(HELP);
      process.exitCode = 1;
  }
}

try {
  main(process.argv);
} catch (err) {
  if (process.env.MEMO_DEBUG === '1') {
    console.error(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err);
  } else {
    console.error('memo: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)));
  }
  process.exit(1);
}

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { repoRoot } = require('./git');
const { memoryDir } = require('./paths');

function command() {
  let root;
  try {
    root = repoRoot(process.cwd());
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error: Run "memo init" first');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const memDir = memoryDir(root);
  if (!fs.existsSync(memDir)) {
    console.error('Error: Run "memo init" first');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const sections = ['progress.md', 'decisions.md', 'errors.md', 'next.md'];
  let brief = '# Memo Brief\n\n';

  for (const section of sections) {
    const filePath = path.join(memDir, section);
    let content = '';
    if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8').trim();
    }
    const title = section.replace('.md', '').charAt(0).toUpperCase() + section.replace('.md', '').slice(1);
    brief += `## ${title}\n\n${content || '_(empty)_'}\n\n`;
  }

  const briefPath = path.join(memDir, 'BRIEF.md');
  fs.writeFileSync(briefPath, brief, 'utf8');
  console.log(`Generated â†’ .memory/BRIEF.md`);
}

module.exports = { command };

'use strict';

const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
const path = require('path');

function run(args, cwd) {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
}

function repoRoot(cwd) {
  try {
    return run(['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], cwd);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error('Not inside a git repo');
  }
}

function hooksDir(root) {
  const p = run(['rev-parse', '--git-path', 'hooks'], root);
  return path.resolve(root, p);
}

module.exports = { run, repoRoot, hooksDir };

```javascript
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { repoRoot } = require('./git');
const { memoryDir, memoHome } = require('./paths');

const MAX_LINES = 150;

function pad(n) {
  return String(n).padStart(2, '0');
}

function getLocalTimestamp() {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
}

function parseEntries(filePath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return [];
  const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  return content
    .split(/(?=^## )/gm)
    .map(p => p.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .reverse();
}

function readAboutMe() {
  const personalPath = path.join(memoHome(), 'personal.md');
  if (!fs.existsSync(personalPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(personalPath, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(l => l.trim() !== '' && !l.startsWith('# '))
    .slice(0, 20);
}

function readOpenNext(memDir) {
  const nextPath = path.join(memDir, 'next.md');
  if (!fs.existsSync(nextPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(nextPath, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(l => l.startsWith('- [ ] '));
}

function buildBrief(root) {
  const memDir = memoryDir(root);
  const repoName = path.basename(root);
  const timestamp = getLocalTimestamp();
  const aboutMe = readAboutMe();

  const commits = parseEntries(path.join(memDir, 'progress.md')).slice(0, 10);
  const decisions = parseEntries(path.join(memDir, 'decisions.md')).slice(0, 10);
  const errors = parseEntries(path.join(memDir, 'errors.md')).slice(0, 5);
  const next = readOpenNext(memDir);

  function section(title, items, sep) {
    return [`## ${title}`, items.length > 0 ? items.join(sep) : '(none yet)', ''];
  }

  function assemble() {
    const lines = [
      `# BRIEF — ${repoName}`,
      `Generated ${timestamp} by memo. Do not edit; run \`memo brief\`.`,
      '',
    ];
    if (aboutMe.length > 0) lines.push('## About me', ...aboutMe, '');
    lines.push(...section('Open next steps', next, '\n'));
    lines.push(...section('Recent decisions (last 10)', decisions, '\n\n'));
    lines.push(...section('Recent errors (last 5)', errors, '\n\n'));
    lines.push(...section('Recent commits (last 10)', commits, '\n\n'));
    return lines.join('\n').trimEnd() + '\n';
  }

  let text = assemble();
  while (text.split('\n').length - 1 > MAX_LINES) {
    if (commits.length > 0) commits.pop();
    else if (decisions.length > 0) decisions.pop();
    else if (errors.length > 0) errors.pop();
    else if (next.length > 1) next.pop();
    else if (next.length === 1 && next[0] !== '…truncated in next.md') next[0] = '…truncated in next.md';
    else break;
    text = assemble();
  }
  return text;
}

function command() {
  let root;
  try {
    root = repoRoot(process.cwd());
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error: Run "memo init" first');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const memDir = memoryDir(root);
  if (!fs.existsSync(memDir)) {
    console.error('Error: Run "memo init" first');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const content = buildBrief(root);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(memDir, 'BRIEF.md'), content, 'utf8');
  console.log(`BRIEF.md written (${content.split('\n').length - 1} lines)`);
}

module.exports = { buildBrief, command };

```

## Ye error kiska hai?

Ye error `git apply` ka hai. Patch file ka format kharab hai. Bug na tumhare code mein hai, na Git mein.

## Error kyun aaya?

Gemini ke patch mein teen problems hain:

1. **Line count galat hai (isi se "line 13" wala error aaya).** Hunk header `@@ -13,6 +13,8 @@` kehta hai ki 6 purani lines aayengi, par patch mein sirf 5 hain. Git chhathi line dhoondta raha, aur line 13 pe usse `diff --git` mila, isliye usne patch ko corrupt bataya.
2. **Ek khaali line pe `+` nahi hai.** `src/brief.js` mein `return briefText;` se pehle wali khaali line pe `+` laga hona chahiye tha. Wo bhi patch ko corrupt karta.
3. **Sabse badi problem: Gemini ne code ka andaaza lagaya.**
   - Tumhara [bin/memo.js](bin/memo.js) `switch` use karta hai aur usme `brief` pehle se juda hua hai. Patch ek `if/else` dhoondh raha hai jo file mein hai hi nahi.
   - [src/brief.js](src/brief.js) pehle se maujood hai, par patch use "new file" bata raha hai.
   - Patch `.run()` export karta hai, jabki memo.js `.command()` call karta hai.

   Isliye line count theek karke bhi ye patch kabhi apply nahi hota.

LLM ye galtiyaan isliye karte hain kyunki wo diff ko text ki tarah likhte hain. Line ginne mein wo kamzor hote hain, aur zip mein jo file asal mein hai uski jagah apni yaad se code likh dete hain.

Ek aur cheez dhyan rakhna: PowerShell mein `git diff > file.patch` ya `Out-File` patch mein Windows wali CRLF line endings daal deta hai. Tumhara repo LF use karta hai (`eol=lf`), toh aisa patch bhi fail hoga. Patch save karne ke liye `git diff --output=file.patch` use karo.
